verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents a project-level Brewfile with `brew bundle install` as a single command for installing project dependencies, including in CI such as GitHub Actions. It supports unattended use via `NONINTERACTIVE=1`, `--yes`, and use in administrative scripts and scheduled jobs. Exit codes are only implied by the documented `brew bundle check || brew bundle install` scripting pattern. missing for 10: documented exit-code semantics for install/upgrade failures, evidence of clear machine-readable error output, explicit non-interactive dependency-update flow for Brewfiles, independent hands-on corroboration of agent/CI reliability
